chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated this hadith from Mūsā ibn ʿUmar, from Sulaymān ibn Ḥafṣ al-Marwazī.

key_terms.سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ الْمَرْوَزِيِّ: the narrator from whom the report is transmitted
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارُ: the transmitter Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār
key_terms.مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ: an intermediary narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the narrator chain mentioned for this hadith in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This text presents a sanad/isnad note identifying an alternative transmission route for the hadith. It records that Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated it through Mūsā ibn ʿUmar from Sulaymān ibn Ḥafṣ al-Marwazī, which is relevant to hadith transmission and documentation.
